title: (RHBA-2018:0970) rt-tests bug fix update
portal_summary: An update for rt-tests is now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for Real Time for NFV|7|x86_64
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for Real Time|7|x86_64
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for Real Time for x86_64 - Extended Life Cycle Support|7|x86_64
portal_solution:
For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The rt-tests packages include a set of programs that test and measure various components of real-time kernel behavior. These packages measure timer, signal, and hardware latency and test the functioning of priority-inheritance mutexes.

For detailed information on changes in this release, see the Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.5 Release Notes linked from the References section.

Users of rt-tests are advised to upgrade to these updated packages.
